pages.text: A fifth dimension curled into a circle of radius R₅ shows up as a tower of Kaluza-Klein particles of mass nħc/R₅. A 4-cube rotated against our space casts a 3-D shadow whose volume (Cauchy) is the sum of |nᵢ| over the components of its tilt.
$(thing)Set$(): Compact radius R₅, xw rotation α, yw rotation β, Stabiliser field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Rotation-stage backlash: the xw angle is α + 0.5°·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Radion not stabilised: R₅ drifts; Interlock: radion-stabiliser coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the radion-stabiliser coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Assembly runs at a fixed pace.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)First KK mass: m₁ = ħc/R₅$(br)First KK mass: log₁₀ m₁$(br)Shadow volume: V = Σ|nᵢ|  (Cauchy projection formula)$(br)Radion field needed: B ≥ 1 + 2·log₁₀(1 + m₁)$(br)Critical field: B_c(T) = B_c2(0)·(1 − (T/T_c)²)
